ops.body:
Routing the root foundation reviews (reviews/orca-foundation.json FAIL, reviews/reposync-snapshot-foundation.json FAIL) without interrupting active implementers. Run wf_e4a4614a-30e runs two fix lanes branched from the reviewed foundation commits, then an astra verification of each fix against the report, then a refix pass.
Orca, branch cc-sync/xmr-root-fixes from f0a364cc, worktree /Users/yasyf/.claude/worktrees/orca/xmr-root-fixes:
- Exclude origin 'recovery' from every automatic launcher, including the legacy resumeSleepingAgentSessionsForWorktree sweep, background wake and cold restore.
- Scope-aware binding identity: a generic RecoveryBindingKey {agent,key,id,transcriptPath for pi/prime-agent} API; v1 exports Claude bindings only and reports the rest as omittedBindings; a bare id is accepted only when unambiguous.
- instanceId is required for presentation worktree refs and matched exactly (no wildcard).
- Folder workspaces copy recoveryProvenance.
reposync, branch cc-sync/worktree-root-fixes from 436cf13, worktree /Users/yasyf/.claude/worktrees/reposync/root-fixes:
- One size per digest across all snapshot refs.
- Worktree ID recomputed from origin/root/incarnation and Head object-id validation.
- Locate handles relative inputs and missing descendants under symlinked ancestors.
- Escape-safe jj workspace template for tab/newline paths.
Ordering: the Orca workflow's fix stage now always runs before QA. It waits for reviews/orca-root-fixes.READY (the coordinator writes it only after the fix is verified), merges the root fixes, and applies delta D2/D7/D12b. The coordinator stops and resumes wf_dabe0930-23d on the edited script once Orca integration completes; cached lanes replay. The reposync root fixes merge in the reposync delta lane together with worktree.Stamp.
